They can work, but usually only if they’re temporary — a few months apart for work, studies, or a project — and there’s a clear end date when you’ll be back together. Otherwise, you’re basically playing Russian roulette. And when your girlfriend is at parties being carried around by other guys? That’s not “you being insecure,” that’s straight-up disrespect. Best case, she has zero empathy and doesn’t care how it makes you feel. Worst case, she’s already cheating. Either way, you deserve better. Why Ronaldo Breaks Her Haaland Theory. A creator argued that women are not pining over Haaland because he is tall, rich and famous, but because of how he comes across. Are Looks All That Matter In Dating? My Take On Black Pill. I originally made this video for my paid subscribers, but the message felt too important to keep behind a paywall. Is Being A Student More Dangerous Than Being A Cop? A creator claims that being a public-school student carries more risk than being a police officer, based on raw incident numbers. Prejudice Against Men Is Not Real? A creator argues that prejudice against men is not a real thing in society because there are no systemic barriers directed at men. Mamdani's Rent Freeze - Good Or Bad. Part 1. Mamdani's rent freeze is not a freeze on all NYC rents - it covers rent-stabilized apartments, roughly one million units, about 41% of the city's rentals. It is real money for rent-stabilized tenants, but it works like a painkiller - it eases the pain without treating the cause, which is too many people fighting over too few homes. I break down the insider-outsider problem, the pressure on smaller landlords, and why the plan to build 200,000 units over 10 years is far more ambitious than it sounds. #nyc #housing #economics #rentfreeze #factcheck

Mamdani's Rent Freeze. Responding To Simple Black Theory. Simple Black Theory responded to my earlier educational video on rent control and framed it as if it were about NYC and Mamdani's rent freeze, so here I go through his points. #nyc #housing #economics #rentfreeze #reaction

We Lived In Matriarchy For 25,000 Years? Do Men Have Rights? Do Men Have Feelings?
